title: Introducing Inkling 2 Small
raw_excerpt: Inkling 2 Small is a Mixture-of-Experts model with 594B total parameters, 17B active, that supports image inputs and variable effort. The model's vision and agentic capabilities enable it to incorporate visual feedback to iteratively build and refine websites, games, and 3D designs with interactive elements. It will be initially available through Tinker with closed weights. Full weights will be available under an Apache 2.0 license next week after the completion of external safety testing and red-teaming.
summary: Thinking Machines Lab（Mira Murati 创立）发布第二代模型 Inkling 2 Small：594B 总参数、17B 激活的 MoE 架构，支持图像输入与可变推理强度，可借助视觉反馈迭代构建网站、游戏和 3D 设计。第三方评测称其权重放出后将成为中国以外得分最高的开放权重模型，下周以 Apache 2.0 开源。这是美国团队首次在开源权重赛道上正面挑战中国模型。

title: GPT-6 Cyber
raw_excerpt: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity model designed to identify and validate exploitable vulnerabilities while staying within researcher-defined boundaries.
summary: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6 Cyber，一款专为网络安全设计的模型，能在研究者设定的边界内识别并验证可利用漏洞。结合此前 OpenAI 用 AI 在 Linux 内核中发现 948 个本地提权漏洞的消息，这标志着前沿模型正被系统性地用于攻防安全研究，也引发关于 AI 自主发现漏洞能力边界的讨论。

title: Independent Assessment of AI R&D Acceleration at Anthropic in October 2026
raw_excerpt: Anthropic's AI R&D capabilities accelerated significantly, improving model performance on well-defined tasks at roughly twice the rate compared to 2024-2025. This acceleration primarily results from AI's increasing role in R&D, though multiple factors contributed in late 2025.
summary: METR 发布对 Anthropic 2026 年 10 月 AI 研发加速情况的独立评估：Anthropic 模型在明确定义任务上的性能提升速度约为 2024-2025 年的两倍，加速主要源于 AI 在研发流程中角色加重。这是少有的第三方对“AI 加速 AI 研发”这一关键假设的量化验证，对理解递归自我改进节奏有重要参考价值。

title: OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion, as rival Anthropic nears its IPO
raw_excerpt: OpenAI is now valued at $1.25 trillion in a new round of funding that has raised another $11 billion, according to Bloomberg . That would make it one of the world's most valuable companies, not long after raising  $122 billion from investors in March at a valuation of $852 billion. Echoing FT and Wall Street Journal reports from last week, Bloomberg says OpenAI is still pursuing additional investments that could increase the amount to $20 billion, and that it had initially hoped to raise as much as $30 billion at a higher valuation of $1.4 trillion. That was before tech stocks dropped, and the results of the midterms showed how much public o … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 据彭博社报道，OpenAI 新一轮融资已完成约 110 亿美元首期款项，估值达 1.25 万亿美元，成为全球市值最高公司之一；此前 3 月曾以 8520 亿美元估值融资 1220 亿美元。公司仍在争取追加至 200 亿美元，原目标为 1.4 万亿估值下融资 300 亿美元，因科技股回调而缩水。与此同时竞争对手 Anthropic 的 IPO 估值预期已下调至 1.1 万亿至 1.3 万亿美元区间。

title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
raw_excerpt: Google introduces Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, enhancing speed, cost-efficiency, and extended clip lengths for AI models. This update aims to improve developer tools and effectiveness in AI applications.
summary: Google 发布 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，在速度、成本效率和视频片段长度上均有提升，面向开发者工具场景优化。这是 Gemini 多模态产品线的持续迭代，进一步压低多模态推理的单位成本，对依赖视频理解与生成的开发者应用有直接影响。

title: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation
raw_excerpt: NVIDIA's Cosmos 3 platform now offers four open-weight models for interactive world simulation and driving scenes, each with 16 billion trainable parameters. These models enable multi-sensor data generation, synchronized observations, and photorealistic video from simulator controls, supporting advanced research in robotics and autonomous driving.
summary: NVIDIA 在 Hugging Face 发布 Cosmos 3 平台四款开放权重世界模型，每款含 160 亿可训练参数，支持交互式世界模拟与驾驶场景，可生成多传感器数据、同步观测及由模拟器控制的光真实视频。这为机器人和自动驾驶研究提供了可复现的世界模型基座，是物理 AI 方向的重要开源基础设施。

title: The benchmark where AIs have to lie to win
raw_excerpt: Blood on the Clocktower is a social deception game. Watching AI play the game unveils a lot about how AI is progressing on a set of AI capabilities that no other benchmark gives clear visibility into. The game requires AI to execute schemes with creativity, on-the-spot bluffing, and collective reasoning. This post looks at what happens when you pit AI models against each other in the game.
summary: Dwarkesh Patel 撰文分析用社交欺骗游戏《血染钟楼》评测 AI 的实践：该游戏要求模型创造性地执行骗局、临场虚张声势并进行集体推理，能揭示其他 benchmark 无法覆盖的能力维度。文章记录了多款前沿模型互相对战的表现，为评估 AI 的欺骗、结盟与心智理论能力提供了新视角。

title: You can now build live apps in Cursor and share them with a link
raw_excerpt: Users just have to describe the tool they want, and Cursor will build it, set up a database, run deterministic and agentic security checks, and deploy.
summary: Cursor 上线新功能：用户只需描述想要的工具，Cursor 即可自动构建应用、配置数据库、执行确定性与智能体安全审查并一键部署，生成可通过链接分享的在线应用。这标志着 AI 编程工具从“写代码”迈向“交付可运行产品”的完整闭环，对低代码与独立开发者生态影响显著。

title: Personal Finance in Claude
raw_excerpt: Anthropic Personal Finance in Claude allows users to securely connect bank and credit card accounts to ask questions about balances, transactions, and spending.
summary: Anthropic 在 Claude 中推出个人理财功能，用户可安全连接银行与信用卡账户，直接询问余额、交易和消费情况。这是 Claude 从通用助手向高敏感个人数据场景延伸的关键一步，也把 AI 助手与金融数据安全、隐私授权的行业议题推到台前。

title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
raw_excerpt: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
summary: Cloudflare 开源 security-audit-skill，一个供编码智能体使用的多阶段安全审计技能，产出可独立验证、机器可读的发现结果。该项目单日获 2548 星，反映“Agent Skills”正成为智能体能力封装的事实标准，也显示安全审计这一高价值场景正被智能体工具链快速覆盖。
